page: Microsoft Azure E2ds_v7 is an Edsv7-family virtual machine configured with 2 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB RAM-per-core ratio. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor running at 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled for a total of 2 threads. The CPU includes a 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) for hardware-accelerated operations. Storage is provided via a 118 GB local disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2215.58 and a PassMark memory score of 1927.71. However, multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics are generally constrained. The stress-ng multi-core CPU score is 2263.98, and large-block memory write bandwidth is limited to 12.15 GB/sec. For database and key-value workloads, the instance achieves 4.01 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a PassMark database operations score of 1429.99. LLM inference testing shows 88.94 tokens per second for text generation on a small 135M model, though performance drops significantly on larger models.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio, the E2ds_v7 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel processing. The inclusion of a 118 GB local disk and Premium Storage capability supports localized data caching. This virtual machine is suited for small-scale relational databases, caching layers, light web serving, and memory-intensive development environments.
